provider.name: MACH
provider.promise: Fast, low-cost Base data for autonomous agents. No API keys, no subscriptions; pay per call with USDC over x402.

description: Fast, low-cost Base data for autonomous agents. No API keys, no subscriptions; pay per call with USDC over x402.

endpoints.name: block number
endpoints.description: Get the current Base mainnet block number (latest chain height) for an autonomous agent.

endpoints.name: gas price
endpoints.description: Get the current gas price on Base mainnet in wei for transaction fee estimation.

endpoints.name: wallet balance
endpoints.description: Check the native ETH balance of a wallet or address on Base mainnet.

endpoints.name: erc20 balance
endpoints.description: Check a USDC or other ERC-20 token balance for a wallet on Base mainnet.

endpoints.name: nonce
endpoints.description: Get the current transaction nonce for a Base wallet before broadcasting a transaction.

endpoints.name: contract code
endpoints.description: Check whether an address is a smart contract or EOA on Base mainnet by reading deployed bytecode.

endpoints.name: allowance
endpoints.description: Check an ERC-20 token allowance on Base for an owner and spender.

endpoints.name: receipt
endpoints.description: Check whether a Base transaction succeeded, get its receipt, and count current confirmations.

endpoints.name: transaction context
endpoints.description: Verify an onchain payment or investigate a failed Base transaction in one call with transaction, receipt, success status, confirmations, gas and fee context.

endpoints.name: logs
endpoints.description: Query smart-contract event logs on Base by contract address, topics and bounded block range.

endpoints.name: eth call
endpoints.description: Make a read-only smart-contract call on Base with eth_call without sending a transaction.

endpoints.name: transaction
endpoints.description: Get a full Base transaction by hash, including sender, recipient, value, calldata and live transaction details.

endpoints.name: block
endpoints.description: Get a Base block by number or tag with its header and transaction hashes.

endpoints.name: wallet snapshot
endpoints.description: Take a Base wallet snapshot in one call: native ETH plus up to 10 supplied ERC-20 token balances.

endpoints.name: total supply
endpoints.description: Get total supply for an ERC-20 token or ERC-721 NFT contract on Base.

endpoints.name: contract info
endpoints.description: Inspect a Base smart contract and get token metadata, bytecode size and common interface detection in one call.

endpoints.name: erc20 transfers
endpoints.description: Find recent ERC-20 transfers on Base, optionally filtered to transfers from or to a specific wallet.
